'''Siddharth Pandey''' is an Indian chemist and professor working in the field of experimental [[physical chemistry]]. He currently serves as the N. K. Jha Chair Professor at the Department of Chemistry, [[Indian Institute of Technology Delhi]] (IIT Delhi).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Siddharth Pandey |url=https://web.iitd.ac.in/~sipandey/ |website=IIT Delhi}}</ref> He has been a professor at IIT Delhi since April 2011 and previously held the position of Head of the Department from September 2022 to August 2024.<ref name="IITDProfile">{{cite web |title=Prof. Siddharth Pandey |url=https://chemistry.iitd.ac.in/faculty-profile/15 |access-date=19 May 2025 |website=Department of Chemistry, IIT Delhi}}</ref> He has also served as a visiting professor at the [[University of Missouri]], Columbia, USA.<ref name="IITDProfile" /> He started his academic career as an assistant professor at [[New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology|New Mexico Tech]], USA in 2000.

He earned the [[Chemical Research Society of India]] Bronze Medal (2016),<ref name="CRSI">{{cite web |title=Bronze Medal Winners |url=https://crsi-india.org/bronze-medal-winners-for-the-period-2000-2021/ |website=Chemical Research Society of India |access-date=19 May 2025}}</ref> Excellence in Teaching Award from IIT Delhi (2012),<ref name="IITDProfile" /> and was elected as a [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry]] (2015).<ref name="IITDProfile" />

== Early life and education ==
Pandey was born in 1970 in [[Allahabad]] (now [[Prayagraj]]), [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. He completed his school education in Allahabad and secured the first position in the state in the Intermediate Examination conducted by the [[Board of High School and Intermediate Education Uttar Pradesh|Uttar Pradesh Board]] in 1987.<ref name="cv">{{cite web |title=Wayback Machine - Siddharth Pandey |url=https://web.iitd.ac.in/~sipandey/img/CV.pdf |website=web.iitd.ac.in}}</ref>

Pandey pursued his Ph.D. in Chemistry at the [[University of North Texas]], where he worked under the supervision of William E. Acree Jr.<ref name="MDPI2023">{{cite journal |title=Unprecedented High Probe-Reported Polarity of Deep Eutectic Solvents |url=https://www.mdpi.com/2673-8015/4/3/28 |journal=Liquids |date=September 2024 |volume=4 |issue=3 |access-date=19 May 2025 |last1=Anushis |first1=Patra |last2=Vaishali |first2=Khokhar |last3=Siddharth |first3=Pandey }}</ref> He later completed his post-doctoral research at the [[University at Buffalo]], [[State University of New York]] under the guidance of Frank V. Bright.<ref name="MDPI2023" /> He holds a [[Master of Science]] (5-Year Integrated) degree from the [[Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur|IIT Kanpur]], where he conducted research on biprotonic excited-state intermolecular proton transfer in ionic micelles.{{citation needed|date=July 2025}}

== Career ==
Pandey was awarded the N. K. Jha Chair Professorship in 2023 and previously held the Institute Chair Professorship from 2019 to 2023.<ref name="IITDProfile" />

== Research ==
His research primarily focuses on [[optical spectroscopy]], excited-state phenomena, [[optical sensing]], and molecularly organized media. He has worked extensively on [[supercritical fluid]]s, [[ionic liquids]], deep eutectic solvents, fluorous solvents, and renewable solvents.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Pandey |first1=Siddharth |title=Analytical applications of room-temperature ionic liquids: A review of recent efforts |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0003267005010214 |journal=Analytica Chimica Acta |pages=38–45 |doi=10.1016/j.aca.2005.06.038 |date=18 January 2006|volume=556 |issue=1 |pmid=17723329 |bibcode=2006AcAC..556...38P |url-access=subscription }}</ref> His studies also include photophysics of polymers, biomolecules, and pharmaceuticals, as well as [[Carbon capture and storage|carbon dioxide capture and sequestration]]. He has served as an editorial board member of ''[[Scientific Reports]]'' for 10 years and is currently an editor of the ''Journal of Molecular Liquids''.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Baker |first1=Gary A. |last2=Baker |first2=Sheila N. |last3=Pandey |first3=Siddharth |last4=Bright |first4=Frank V. |title=An analytical view of ionic liquids |url=https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2005/an/b500865b |journal=Analyst |pages=800–808 |language=en |doi=10.1039/B500865B |date=23 May 2005|volume=130 |issue=6 |pmid=15912225 |bibcode=2005Ana...130..800B |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
